The '''Imperial Lodgement''' was a military base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located at the western edge of the [[Minimum Security Section]], accessible by the [[Aphor Grove]], it was originally a camp used by Belsavis's first [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explorers, and was converted into a fortified base by the Empire during their [[Invasion of Belsavis|invasion]] of the planet.
